svg.title: A-100 Ground Floor Plan
svg.text: Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. The whole of this floor is one non-residential compartment
under the apartments: 2 hour separation to the floor over,
sprinklered throughout, with a suppression hood over the
2. The service kitchen and laundry serve all four storeys.
Kitchen extract rises in a dedicated fire-rated shaft
within the riser cupboard off the fire lobby, run at high
level from the kitchen and discharged above roof level.
3. Living, reception, entrance lobby and the lounge read as
one connected sequence through 1.00 m arched openings in
the party wall; arch heads are shown dashed.
4. The east boundary wall is solid at this level: the
adjoining owner may build up to 3.00 m against it. The
kitchen and the guest bedroom are daylit from the light
court, and the west wall is opened where it faces our own
5. Bins stand outside in the garden, clear of the patio; the
compact kitchen has no room for an internal bin lobby.
Guest bath, laundry and WC are internal, mechanically
extracted at six air changes per hour.
6. Gross internal area excludes the light court.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P2 2026-09-24 east windows, taller floors, garden on A-100
P3 2026-09-29 four storeys, apartments, straight north boundary
